# Conf42 family media kit

> Logos (SVG/PNG/PDF/EPS in colour, black and white), colours (HEX/RGB/CMYK, design tokens), banners, profile pictures, stickers, mascots, animations (WebP/MP4) and event splashes for Conf42, SREday, LLMday, PLATFORMday, Prompt Engineering Conference, Reliaburger, CFP Ninja, Certified FYI, Badger.
